tables.name: universities
tables.purpose: Universities that students belong to; the email domain is used to verify student status at registration.

columns.name: email_domain
columns.notes: Accepted university email domain, e.g. uni.edu

tables.name: courses
tables.purpose: Courses offered by a university; notes, groups and student enrolments are organized around them.

relationships.notes: Each course belongs to one university

tables.name: topics
tables.purpose: Reusable topic tags that can be attached to notes.

tables.name: users
tables.purpose: Registered student accounts, with authentication, verification, suspension and soft-delete state.

columns.name: university_id
columns.notes: FK to universities.id; derived from the email domain

columns.name: email_verified_at
columns.notes: Set when the verification link is confirmed

columns.name: suspended_until
columns.notes: Null with status suspended means indefinite suspension

columns.name: deleted_at
columns.notes: Soft-delete marker for GDPR erasure workflow

relationships.notes: Each user belongs to one university

tables.name: user_profiles
tables.purpose: Public profile information for each user (one profile per user).

columns.name: user_id
columns.notes: FK to users.id; unique enforces one-to-one

columns.name: avatar_s3_key
columns.notes: S3 object key of the avatar image

relationships.notes: Profile is deleted with the user

tables.name: roles
tables.purpose: Platform-wide roles: student, moderator, platform_admin. Group Admin is group-scoped and stored in group_members.

tables.name: user_roles
tables.purpose: Junction table assigning platform roles to users (many-to-many).

columns.name: assigned_by
columns.notes: FK to users.id; admin who granted the role

tables.name: email_verification_tokens
tables.purpose: Single-use tokens emailed to users to verify their university email and activate the account.

columns.name: token_hash
columns.notes: Hash of the token sent by email

tables.name: interests
tables.purpose: Catalog of interests that users can list on their profiles.

tables.name: user_interests
tables.purpose: Junction table linking users to their interests (many-to-many).

tables.name: user_courses
tables.purpose: Junction table linking users to the courses they are taking (many-to-many).

tables.name: notes
tables.purpose: Study notes shared by students, tagged to a course, with denormalized rating and download statistics.

columns.name: author_id
columns.notes: FK to users.id; set to null when the author's account is erased, so the note can be anonymized or removed

columns.name: average_rating
columns.notes: Denormalized average of note_ratings; updated on rating changes

columns.name: search_vector
columns.notes: Implement as PostgreSQL tsvector generated from title and description; GIN index for relevance-ranked search

columns.name: removed_at
columns.notes: Set when a moderator removes the note; hides it from all users

tables.name: note_files
tables.purpose: Files (PDF or image) attached to a note and stored in AWS S3, with malware scan status.

tables.name: note_topics
tables.purpose: Junction table tagging notes with topics (many-to-many).

tables.name: note_downloads
tables.purpose: Log of note downloads for statistics and relevance ranking.

columns.name: user_id
columns.notes: FK to users.id; nulled on account erasure

tables.name: note_ratings
tables.purpose: 1-5 star ratings given by users to notes; one rating per user per note.

tables.name: note_comments
tables.purpose: Comments left by users on notes, with optional threaded replies.

columns.name: user_id
columns.notes: FK to users.id; nulled on account erasure

tables.name: note_bookmarks
tables.purpose: Junction table recording notes bookmarked by users (many-to-many).

tables.name: study_groups
tables.purpose: Public or private study groups created around a course or subject.

columns.name: course_id
columns.notes: FK to courses.id; null for general subject groups

columns.name: created_by
columns.notes: FK to users.id; the creator who becomes the first admin

columns.name: subject
columns.notes: Free-text subject when not tied to a course

tables.name: group_members
tables.purpose: Junction table of group membership, including the member's role in the group (member or admin).

columns.name: role
columns.notes: member | admin; the Group Admin role is scoped to the group

tables.name: group_join_requests
tables.purpose: Requests to join private groups that a group admin approves or rejects.

columns.name: reviewed_by
columns.notes: FK to users.id; the admin who decided

tables.name: reports
tables.purpose: User reports of inappropriate or copyrighted notes or comments, forming the moderator queue.

columns.name: reporter_id
columns.notes: FK to users.id; nulled on account erasure

columns.name: note_id
columns.notes: FK to notes.id; set when a note is reported

columns.name: comment_id
columns.notes: FK to note_comments.id; set when a comment is reported. CHECK exactly one of note_id or comment_id is not null

columns.name: resolved_by
columns.notes: FK to users.id; moderator who closed the report

tables.name: moderation_actions
tables.purpose: Audit log of moderator actions such as removing content and suspending users.

columns.name: moderator_id
columns.notes: FK to users.id; the acting moderator

columns.name: report_id
columns.notes: FK to reports.id; null for proactive actions

columns.name: target_user_id
columns.notes: FK to users.id; user suspended or notified

columns.name: action_type
columns.notes: remove_note | remove_comment | restore_content | suspend_user | unsuspend_user | dismiss_report

tables.name: notifications
tables.purpose: In-app notifications, e.g. content removal notices to authors and join request outcomes.

columns.name: type
columns.notes: note_removed | comment_removed | join_request_received | join_request_approved | join_request_rejected | account_suspended | new_comment | new_rating

columns.name: note_id
columns.notes: FK to notes.id; optional related note

columns.name: group_id
columns.notes: FK to study_groups.id; optional related group

tables.name: account_deletion_requests
tables.purpose: Tracks GDPR account and personal data deletion requests, to be completed within 30 days.

columns.name: user_id
columns.notes: FK to users.id; nulled once the user row is purged

assumptions: PostgreSQL is the target database; uuid primary keys are generated with gen_random_uuid() (pgcrypto or PostgreSQL 13+).
Every table has exactly one primary key column named id; junction tables use a surrogate uuid id plus a composite unique index (listed in indexes) instead of a composite primary key.

Index entries written as unique(a, b) denote composite unique constraints; entries with (GIN) denote the index type; plain names denote single-column btree indexes. The composite index entry on notifications is on (user_id, is_read, created_at).
The Group Admin role is scoped to a group and stored in group_members.role; Student, Moderator and Platform Administrator are global roles in roles/user_roles.
Passwords are stored only as bcrypt hashes in users.password_hash; JWTs are stateless, so no session or refresh-token table is included.
The university is derived by matching the registration email domain to universities.email_domain, which verifies student status together with the emailed verification token.
Files are stored in AWS S3; only object keys and metadata are stored in the database. Notes remain unpublished (status pending_scan) until the malware scan marks every file clean.
Notes.average_rating and rating_count are denormalized and updated in the same transaction as writes to note_ratings, so the average updates immediately.

Moderator removal sets notes.status to removed and removed_at, which hides the note from all users; a notification row informs the author. Comments are hidden by setting note_comments.status to removed.

A report targets either a note or a comment; a CHECK constraint must enforce that exactly one of note_id or comment_id is not null. Users are suspended via users.status and suspended_until, with the action logged in moderation_actions.
Rating values are constrained to 1-5 with a CHECK constraint; reports.reason, statuses and visibility values are enforced with CHECK constraints or enums at the application layer.

GDPR erasure: account_deletion_requests tracks the 30-day window. Users are soft-deleted first, then personal data (users, user_profiles, tokens, bookmarks, ratings, memberships) is purged. Content authored by the user is deleted or anonymized by setting the nullable author, user and reporter foreign keys to null.

Foreign key delete behavior is assumed: ON DELETE CASCADE for dependent child and junction rows (profiles, tokens, note files, note_topics, ratings, bookmarks, group_members, join requests, user_courses, user_interests); ON DELETE SET NULL for nullable audit and authorship references.
The search_vector column is stored as a PostgreSQL tsvector (shown as text for portability) and is indexed with GIN for keyword search; course filtering uses the course_id index.
A partial unique index on group_join_requests(group_id, user_id) WHERE status = 'pending' prevents duplicate pending requests.
Public groups let users join directly by inserting into group_members; private groups require a group_join_requests row to be approved by a group admin.
